topology: NV18 between all GPU pairs; GPUs0-3 NUMA0 CPU0-89
nccl_transport: P2P/CUMEM; actual rank/GPU bus IDs in validate-tp2/4 server.stdout
kv_capacity_note: Automatic per-instance capacity at 0.45 memory utilization per GPU; TP ranks use minimum local capacity. Different TP sizes have different total KV capacities. Traces fit even the TP1 pool.
performance_protocol: Nine representative cases, fresh process per policy/TP/case, one distinct-prefix warmup and one measured replay; no profiler in performance matrix. Not a full Cartesian product or confidence-interval experiment.

statistical_definitions.itl_p95: P95 over individual token gaps, excluding first tokens
statistical_definitions.tpot_p95: P95 over per-request mean token gaps
statistical_definitions.goodput: Requests meeting both TTFT and request-mean TPOT SLO per elapsed second
